quest.title: Rapid Restitution to the Raging Fish...
quest.description: Sigewinne seems to have something to tell us...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I'm convinced that our search for a cure is entering its final stages.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: But besides finding a few more aquatic patients to complete the list, I have another, more particular request...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I need you to locate some key underwater mechanisms in the affected waters and retrieve the data recorded by their sensors...

choices.text: Then analyze the data to uncover any relevant patterns...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We should also talk to the boat owners and divers to make sure they've learned their lessons!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: That's right, not to mention the fishermen and the tourists... Anyone who takes a boat out on the surface, and those who dive beneath it...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Everyone who interacts with our waters needs to be mindful. They can't just dump things in the sea and go around destroying marine habitats.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Otherwise, some very aggressive fish might come along and capsize their boats!

choices.text: So we can prevent similar incidents in the future?
